warehouse_origin_key_check.name: warehouse_origin_key_check
warehouse_origin_key_check.value: "app"."warehouse"."origin_key" IS NULL OR ("app"."warehouse"."origin_key" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' AND "app"."warehouse"."province" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."warehouse"."district" IS NOT NULL)

warehouse_pickup_profile_value_check.name: warehouse_pickup_profile_value_check
warehouse_pickup_profile_value_check.value: "app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."revision">0 AND ("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."street_address" IS NULL OR char_length("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."street_address") between 10 and 300) AND ("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."pic_name" IS NULL OR char_length("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."pic_name") between 2 and 120) AND ("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."pic_phone" IS NULL OR "app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."pic_phone" ~ '^62[1-9][0-9]{7,12}$') AND (("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."latitude_e6" IS NULL)=("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."longitude_e6" IS NULL)) AND ("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."latitude_e6" IS NULL OR ("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."latitude_e6" between -11000000 and 6000000 AND "app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."longitude_e6" between 95000000 and 141000000)) AND char_length("app"."warehouse_pickup_profile"."reason") between 1 and 200

warehouse_transfer_state_check.name: warehouse_transfer_state_check
warehouse_transfer_state_check.value: ("app"."warehouse_transfer"."status" IN ('requested','cancelled') AND "app"."warehouse_transfer"."received_quantity"=0) OR "app"."warehouse_transfer"."status" IN ('dispatched','exception') OR ("app"."warehouse_transfer"."status"='received' AND "app"."warehouse_transfer"."received_quantity"="app"."warehouse_transfer"."quantity")
